title: The Dark Truth About Cat Eyed Boy #Shorts
description:
Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Cat Eyed Boy shows exactly where that breaks. Cat Eyed Boy (Japanese: 猫目小僧, Hepburn: Nekome Kozō) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Kazuo Umezu. The story is narrated by the titular cat-eyed boy, hated by both humans and demons, who gets involved in tales of horror including monsters and children.

Nihilism is not the conclusion of Cat Eyed Boy — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. ComicBooksBin enjoyed Umezu's approach to horror where he eschews logic, contrasting it with American horror. In a 2008 reader poll of seinen manga by About.com, Cat Eyed Boy won 8th place.
